recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current core source satisfies FHIR-46562 after accounting for the later FHIR-51716 naming correction; no additional FHIR core edit is needed.
issue_request: FHIR-46562 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 reporting that the DeviceDefinition `type` search parameter searched `DeviceDefinition.conformsTo.category` instead of `DeviceDefinition.classification.type`; it requested separate token search parameters for conformance category and classification type.
initial_application: Commit d1a19f14c66e1beca2ddfa4883f2925af653e96c, linked from the Jira comments and PR 3578, changed the DeviceDefinition `type` search parameter path/expression to `DeviceDefinition.classification.type` and added a separate search parameter for `DeviceDefinition.conformsTo.category`.
additional_context: `source/fhir.ini` actively includes DeviceDefinition, so the inspected search-parameter bundle is in build scope. Later Applied technical correction FHIR-51716 intentionally renamed the added conformance-category parameter to `DeviceDefinition-conformsTo-category` with public code `conforms-to-category` to avoid conflict with `type`. OO minutes referenced follow-up DeviceDefinition search-parameter corrections, and no Zulip discussion was found for FHIR-46562.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current source and the combined branch already define `DeviceDefinition-type` on `DeviceDefinition.classification.type` and a separate `DeviceDefinition-conformsTo-category` search parameter on `DeviceDefinition.conformsTo.category`.
